title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11920)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11920) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11920). This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 5550-1978 'Caseins and caseinates*— Determination of water content (Reference method)', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendations of the Dairy Products Sectional Committee and approval of the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council. In the adopted standard, certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standard; attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they shall be read as 'Indian Standard'; and b) Comma ( , ) has been used as decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use point ( . ) as the decimal marker. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
